name: Element
description:
Element is a secure, decentralized chat and collaboration client built on the Matrix protocol. It provides end-to-end encrypted messaging, voice calls, video meetings, and file sharing for personal and organizational communication.

Features:
- End-to-end encryption for 1-to-1 chats and group rooms by default
- Voice and video calling powered by WebRTC with group conferencing
- Decentralized architecture allowing connection to any Matrix homeserver
- Rich formatting with Markdown, file attachments, and emoji reactions
- Integrates with external bridges for IRC, Slack, Discord, and Telegram
